{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''production facility''', capable of constructing [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]], was operated by the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Pirates had acquired the production facility and restarted it after the SoroSuub Corporation had abandoned the project after producing only a few production models. As part of a deal with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], the Cavrilhu Pirates supplied the Preybirds to the Remnant in exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] and tactical assistance.
